title: 1995 Russia 1000 Rubles Banknote Vladivostok P-261 Circulated Russian Currency
descriptionText:
Condition: Pre-Owned / Circulated

Description:

Authentic 1995 Bank of Russia 1,000 Rubles banknote featuring Vladivostok.

The front depicts Vladivostok Harbor and the commemorative rostral column with sailing ship. The reverse features the coastal rock formations and lighthouse near Vladivostok. This note is cataloged as Pick #261. (PMG Notes⁠￼)

Serial number: AC 9640372

This banknote is circulated and shows visible signs of age and handling, including light creasing, edge/corner wear, small marks, and discoloration/staining visible in the photos. No professional grade has been assigned.

Please review all photos carefully, as they show the exact banknote you will receive and are considered part of the condition description.

Item Specifics:

* Country: Russia
* Denomination: 1,000 Rubles
* Year: 1995
* Type: Banknote
* Circulated/Uncirculated: Circulated
* Certification: Uncertified
* Grade: Ungraded
* Serial Number: AC 9640372
* Pick Number: P-261
* Material: Paper
* Theme: Vladivostok
* Approx. Size: 137 x 61 mm (Numista⁠￼)
